SELECT ui.*, ma.MARKET AS market FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR ui LEFT JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH ma ON ma.USERID = ui.USERID WHERE 1=1 AND ui.USERID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%') AND ui.USERNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') AND ma.MARKET = #{market}
